text:
You need a WordPress booking form that combines weather, service selection with price calculation, available time slots, distance calculation, and a client account area, all wrapped in a flexible page template.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I build full-stack booking and portal systems with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. In a recent Clinic patient portal, I built booking, lab results, and SMS reminders, with every record view written to an audit trail; it served 11k patients and helped cut no-shows by 18% after reminders.

I can help you recreate the same order-flow logic in WordPress and keep the UX close to your reference. Would you like this built as a custom WordPress plugin, or should it be integrated into an existing theme and plugin setup?
